sections.heading: C2 — KG hints for Regulatory and Warning Signs
sections.markdown:
## C2 — KG hints for Regulatory and Warning Signs

FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A01
The stop sign demands a full halt with a two-point visibility maneuver, while the yield sign asks only that you slow down and give way [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint intersection-control; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec03-F07 and sec03-F08.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A01
A posted maximum assumes ideal conditions and invites you to go slower when grip or sight fails, while a posted minimum is a floor that should send too-slow drivers to another route [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint speed-rules; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec03-F02 and sec03-F03.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A01
Do-not-enter signs forbid you from going in, while the wrong-way sign tells you the mistake already happened and orders an escape off the traveled road [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint direction-signs; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec03-F11 and sec03-F12.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A01
The one-way sign channels traffic along its arrow, while the divided-highway sign announces a split ahead with an island or barrier to drive around [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint direction-signs; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec03-F09 and sec03-F10.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A01
Lane control signs tell you where you may go or turn, while no-passing signs tell you where passing is unsafe [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint lane-control; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec03-F04 and sec03-F05.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A01
The blue rail-crossing sign summons railroad help by phone with a crossing ID, while stop and yield signs command intersection behavior [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint rail-signs; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec03-F06, sec03-F07, and sec03-F08.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A02
Divided-begins warns that two-way traffic is about to split, while divided-ends warns that the split is over and oncoming traffic returns [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint roadway-transitions; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec03-F18 and sec03-F19.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec03-R08 | anchor: A02
A crossroad sign means another road crosses your continuing road, while a T-intersection sign means your road ends entirely [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint intersection-warnings; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec03-F14 and sec03-F26.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec03-R09 | anchor: A02
The gradual-curve sign announces a gentle bend, while chevrons reinforce a curve that needs extra emphasis [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint curve-warnings; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec03-F28 and sec03-F30.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec03-R10 | anchor: A02
School-bus-stop-ahead warns of children boarding a bus, while advance-school-crossing warns of a marked crossing near a school [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint school-warnings; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec03-F27 and sec03-F32.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec03-R11 | anchor: A02
Horse-drawn vehicles and farm machinery draw the same response of slower speed and a gentle pass, differing only in what kind of slow mover to expect [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint slow-movers; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec03-F20 and sec03-F22.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec03-R12 | anchor: A02
Signal-ahead promises a stoplight at an upcoming intersection, while merging-traffic warns that other vehicles will blend into your lane [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint intersection-warnings; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec03-F15 and sec03-F16.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0009]
